Not just a meal. An experience! Great!
Jan 2026 • Solo
Bistro 9 is sometimes nicely quiet and sometimes buzzing with happy chat from happy customers. The restaurant is arty, colourful.... and decidedly French in character. I ordered the liver pate which was delicious. I received home baked toast with my delicious pate and (unexpectedly) 5 mini today-baked baguettes. A feast! The staff are super friendly and friendly with each other which creates a great ambiance. All the staff go out of their way to be lovely with customers. Trang who manages the restaurant is welcoming and super organised. The owner, a different Trang, has created a very special French/Viet style haven. The restaurant has flowers on every table and French-style artily folded napkins. On a previous visit my eggs on toast came with a great French salad. Perfect! Both Trangs are clearly very proud of what they are offering at Bistro 9. Come during the build up to the Tet festival and see the restaurant frontage decorated with authentic Vietnamese reds and golds and stylish flair. A meal here is not just a meal. It's an experience! I can heartily recommend! (from 2025 and 2026 visits)
